trap.wrong: This proposal outline a new service.
trap.right: This proposal outlines a new service.
trap.why: O sujeito singular this proposal exige -s; o brasileiro esquece porque o verbo português não depende de “this”.

fix.right: The aim is to build understanding.

The aim is to build trust.
